title: Baluchistan Tribal Areas Validation of Transfer of Properties Regulation 1979

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Tribal Areas Validation of Transfer of Properties Regulation 1979
sections.description:
Short title extent and commencement

REGULATION 1 OF 1979
REGULATION 1 OF 1979
BALUCHISTAN TRIBAL AREAS (VALIDATION OF
TRANSFER OF PROPERTIES) REGULATION, 1979
1. Short title, extent and commencement.‑(1) This Regulation
may be called the Baluchistan Tribal Areas (Validation of Transfer of
Properties) Regulation, 1979.
(2) `It extends to' the whole
of the Tribal Areas of the Province of Baluchistan.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Tribal Areas Validation of Transfer of Properties Regulation 1979
sections.description:
Validation of transfers

REGULATION 1 OF 1979
REGULATION 1 OF 1979
BALUCHISTAN TRIBAL AREAS (VALIDATION OF
TRANSFER OF PROPERTIES) REGULATION, 1979
2. Validation of transfers.‑‑All properties transferred
in the Tribal Areas of the Province of Baluchistan during the years 1963 to
1973 under Scheme No. VII and Revised Scheme No. VII prepared under subsection
(3) of section 10 of the Displaced Persons (Compensation and Rehabilitation)
Act, 1958 (XXVIII of 1958), shall be deemed to have been validly transferred as
if the said Act and Schemes were in force in those Areas at the time when the
properties were so transferred.
